description.narrative: The objective of Project Junkiri is to enhance understanding of SRHR (Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights) as well as mental health among students in grades 7, 8, 9, and10 in 3 di?erent districts of Nepal. The increased knowledge of this subject will help in eradicating the taboos and embarrassment associated with SRHR and mental health. This will be achieved through workshops by PSRN-sc volunteers, the establishment of student clubs at the local school, and advocacy e?orts. The primary focus will be on engaging the target group in a variety of activities, including interactive lectures, workshops, and the transfer of knowledge among peers. All initiatives will be tailored based on initial baseline questionnaires. Collaborative e?orts with local stakeholders and individuals of interest will be undertaken to ensure sustainability and gather local support. Additionally, the project will emphasize the capacity building of PSRN-SC and IMCC Nepal, aiming to strengthen our partnership.
